title: 15 Years Later, One of The Greatest Psychological Horrors Still Needs an Anime Remake
content: Sui Ishida is one of the most renowned manga creators of all time, and it’s all thanks to his critically acclaimed debut series, Tokyo Ghoul . The manga was initially released as a one-shot in 2011 before returning with a weekly schedule in Shueisha’s Young Jump magazine a few months later.
author: ComicBook

title: Netflix’s Biggest Fantasy Drops New Look At Beloved Characters Ahead of Season 2
content: Delicious in Dungeon is by far the biggest fantasy anime series on Netflix. Based on the award-winning manga written and illustrated by Ryoko Kui, the anime debuted in Winter 2024, a decade after the manga began serialization.
author: ComicBook

title: 'Hope You're Happy, Lemon' Manga Ends in Next Chapter
content: Mizuki Kishikawa announced on X (formerly Twitter ) on Sunday the Hope You're Happy, Lemon ( Kuso Onna ni Sachiare ) manga will end in the next chapter on September 13. Seven Seas publishes the series in English and describes the story: Sunao Akiyoshi thought he'd left heartbreak behind after swearing off love in…
author: ANN

title: 35 Years Later, Classic Fantasy Isekai Drops New Look At Anime Revival
content: Over the past several decades, the Shonen demographic has dominated the anime and manga industry, sidelining other underrated series. Most of the best-selling manga of all time also fall within this demographic, including One Piece, Dragon Ball , and more.
author: ComicBook

title: Re:ZERO Season 4 Tops Weekly Ranking for the Second Time in Summer 2026 After Episode 15
content: Re:ZERO -Starting Life in Another World- Season 4 has topped the weekly Summer 2026 anime rankings for the second time in Week 9 after its Episode 15. The anime had 16.39% of the total votes this time, while the vote count was the second highest of the season at over 13,000.
author: Anime Corner

title: Persona 4 Revival Game's Videos Highlight Kanji, Yosuke, Chie, Yukiko
content: Atlus revealed new character videos for Persona 4 Revival , a remake of its original 2008 role-playing game, in July and August, and a new video for Kanji on Saturday. The videos below feature Kanji, Yosuke, Chie, and Yukiko respectively.
author: ANN

title: Wandance Gets Stage Play in March 2027
content: A website opened on Saturday to announce Coffee 's Wandance manga is getting a stage play titled Wandance on Stage from March 19-28 at the MoN Takanawa: The Museum of Narratives Box1000 in Tokyo. THE JET BOY BANGERZ from Exile Tribe member Taki will star as Kaboku. Imagine Itо̄ will direct and write the script.

title: Light Novel 'Unnamed Memory: After the End' Concludes with Eighth Volume
content: The official X of Kadokawa's Dengeki no Shinbungei label announced on August 27 that Kuji Furumiya and chibi 's Unnamed Memory: After the End light novel series will end with its eighth volume on December 17.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Kuji Furumiya's Unnamed Memory -after the end- Sequel Light Novel Series Ends in December
content: Dengeki Bunko will also publish an art book titled Unnamed Memory Archives - chibi art works- in December. Furumiya ( A Pale Moon Reverie , Babel ) began serializing the Unnamed Memory story on the "Shōsetsuka ni Narō" website in September 2012, but the story is no longer available on the platform.
author: ANN

title: Medabots S Smartphone Game to Get Global Launch
content: Imagineer announced on Friday that it will release the Medabots S game for iOS and Android devices globally and opened pre-registrations for the game. The game's App Store page lists its release date as January 21, 2027. The game launched in Japan under the title Medarot S: Unlimited Nova in January 2020.
author: ANN
